name: Energy price spike
description: Electricity prices jump for a year, similar to the 2022-23 European energy crisis.

name: New research lab moves in
description: A new lab brings 60 people for good: more than the desks available, more plug loads, coffee and hot water, and more air needed per floor.

name: Heatwave summer
description: A hot summer like 2003 or 2022: cooling demand in June-August is 1.5x normal; the glass atrium and rooms without automatic blinds overheat.

name: Hackathon weekend
description: LauzHack: ~300 people hack for 24 hours (Saturday noon to Sunday noon) in the cafe, halls, classrooms and computer rooms, mostly on the ground floor. Hour-by-hour check, not a money event; occupancy follows the hackathon column of schedule.csv.
